working_definition: Explicit mandatory external requirement or applicability rule is missing/contradicted in a way designed to be unambiguous for challenge scoring.
examples: FHWA-1273 only referenced on a covered federal-aid contract; Buy America explicitly marked applicable but draft says it does not apply.
note: Challenge severity only; not a legal conclusion.

working_definition: Material required contract/bid protection, document, percentage, or workflow is missing or substantially weakened.
examples: 10% bid guaranty changed to 5%; bond coverage reduced; licensing requirement removed; written-change process bypassed.

working_definition: Meaningful procedural, deadline, record-retention, claims, time, or pricing deviation requiring review.
examples: Audit retention shortened; claim deadline altered; unsupported liquidated-damages rate.

working_definition: Minor non-substantive reference or drafting issue that should be corrected but does not change the intended substantive requirement in the challenge dataset.
examples: Minor cross-reference typo or stale descriptive reference deliberately included in future versions.

working_definition: Equivalent/benign wording difference or no issue. Used to test false-positive burden.
examples: Reordered wording that retains the same requirement.
